description: The base -2 digit of n in place, counting from 0 at the right. For 6, which is "11010", place 0 is 0, place 1 is 1, and place 4 is 1. A place past the end is 0. n runs from 0 to 999999999999 and place runs from 0 to 60. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/negabinary-digit
